ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photos access is needed to attach images to notes.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow adding photos to save completed scenes to Photos.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your approximate location is used while the app is open to show local weather. It is not stored.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed to take photos for your characters and scenes.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Show events from your selected calendars alongside your diary.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Show events from your selected calendars alongside your diary.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion access may be used to check device orientation while showing the weather. Motion activity is not saved.
